subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

I left the job because of a __hostile__ working environment.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"hostile"** means unfriendly, antagonistic, or adverse. (शत्रुतापूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example: **The negotiations were difficult due to the **hostile **attitude of the other party.
 
 
 
• **"Friendly"** refers to being kind, pleasant, and supportive. (मित्रवत)
 
 
• **Example: **The new neighbors were very** friendly** and made us feel at home.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'hostile'** is **'friendly'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Morose** (उदास): Sullen and ill-tempered.

 
 
• **Example:** He became **morose** and withdrawn after the accident.
 
 
 
• **Violent** (हिंसक): Using or involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something.
 
 
• **Example: **The protest turned **violent** after the police arrived.
 
 
 
• **Rustic** (ग्रामीण): Relating to the countryside; rural.
 
 
• **Example:** The** rustic **charm of the village attracted many tourists.
 
 

44:Tb89,

The correct answer is Option 2)&
